discoverDialog.title: Discover relationships
discoverDialog.intro: Choose what to look for and where. Nothing runs until you press Run.
discoverDialog.semanticsNoKey: Semantics: not available. No AI vendor has a key. Set one under Admin, AI Models.
discoverDialog.thresholdHint: Suggestions scoring this or more start ticked. The model is told it, and pairs it rates this high are kept without being measured.
discoverDialog.samplesPerColumnHint: The distinct values of each compared column the model is shown.
discoverDialog.cutoffHint: Pairs the model rated from this score up to the threshold are measured on their data.
discoverDialog.sampleSizeHint: The most non-null values read of each column.
discoverDialog.containedAtHint: A pair whose source has this share of its values in a key column is a key relationship.
discoverDialog.sharedCeilingHint: The most a pair scores when neither column is a key.
discoverDialog.modelTypedHint: This vendor does not list its models. Type the model's name.
discoverDialog.modelHelp: The model for this run only. The model assigned on the AI Models page stays as it is.
discoverDialog.limits: Reads up to {{input}} tokens; answers up to {{output}} tokens.
discoverDialog.limitsDefault: Reads up to {{input}} tokens; answers up to {{output}} tokens. These are the default limits: this model's own are not known.
discoverDialog.tablesHint: Empty means every table of the chosen domains.
discoverDialog.sameAsSourceHelp: Relationships are looked for in both directions between any two of the source tables.
discoverDialog.count: At most {{count}} call to the model, covering {{pairs}}.
discoverDialog.count_other: At most {{count}} calls to the model, covering {{pairs}}.
discoverDialog.countAgain: A pair left unanswered may be asked again.
discoverDialog.countBound: Counted from what is registered, without reading any table. The run may make fewer.
discoverDialog.notRead: {{count}} table requires a parameter and is not read: it is compared on its names and descriptions alone.
discoverDialog.notRead_other: {{count}} tables require a parameter and are not read: they are compared on their names and descriptions alone.
discoverDialog.stopping: Stopping after the request in flight. What was found is kept.
discoverDialog.stopped: Stopped. What was found is kept.
discoverDialog.noSuggestions: None of this run's suggestions are waiting.

restore.fromLastRun: These are the fields of your last run.
restore.leftOut: Left out of them, because it no longer holds:
restore.domainsGone: The domain {{names}} is no longer available.
restore.domainsGone_other: The domains {{names}} are no longer available.
restore.tablesGone: {{count}} table is no longer registered there.
restore.tablesGone_other: {{count}} tables are no longer registered there.
restore.vendorNoKey: {{vendor}} has no key, so the model is the assigned one.
restore.modelGone: {{vendor}} no longer lists {{model}}, so the model is the assigned one.
restore.newTables: {{count}} table registered since your last run is in {{domains}}, which it did not look at.
restore.newTables_other: {{count}} tables registered since your last run are in {{domains}}, which it did not look at.
